_source: Squad and tactics (agreed with Carlos Oct 9). Decided: 11 + 9 on the bench, the 8 formations, wing-backs are a formation slot using full-back ratings, mentality is the only team instruction, energy carries across matches. PROPOSALS (agreed Oct 9): 5 substitutions, 5 saved lineups, mentality effect, attack/defence ratings, AI behaviour. Energy and recovery: Carlos Oct 9 - match energy comes from distance covered and involvement (more factors to be decided); the training regime sets how much a player rests (light = full recovery).
_mentalityNote: 5 steps from very defensive (-2) to very attacking (+2). Each step toward attacking: +8% goals scored, +6% goals conceded (defensive is the reverse).
_ratingNote: Sim mode: attack = average of the midfield and attack slots (attack slots count double); defence = average of the goalkeeper (counts double), defence and midfield slots. Expected goals = base x e^(strengthFactor x (our attack - their defence)) (match-sim.json).
_energyNote: Energy 0-100. Match cost (Carlos Oct 9): distance covered plus being active - passes and shots take power (goals and assists don't matter); more factors may come. Cost = (km x energyPerKm + passes x energyPerPass + shots x energyPerShot) x stamina factor. In sim mode km, passes and shots are estimated from the position, the mentality and the minutes played; the 3D match will measure them. Stamina factor = 1.25 - 0.5 x stamina/100 (stamina 50 = x1.0). Below 80 energy the player plays worse: -0.4% per point (50 energy = -12%).
_regimeNote: Carlos Oct 9: the training regime sets how much a player rests. Light = full recovery every week; moderate and heavy recover less but grow faster (development.json regimes). Injured players heal at the same pace whatever the regime (PROPOSAL).
_aiNote: AI clubs: the formation that best fits their squad (rechecked each week); the best 11 for it, counting energy; light regime for players under 60 energy, otherwise moderate; mentality by relative strength: defensive as a clear underdog (8+ points weaker), attacking as a clear favourite (8+ stronger); unrelated positions only in emergencies.
_assistantNote: Assistant manager (Carlos, Oct 10; on by default, the user can switch each part off): picks the mentality for each match by the AI rule, and moves the user's players under 60 energy to the light regime, back to their regime at 85.
